'''Jaiteh Yasin''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassador]] who visited the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]].<ref name="Peaces">{{LivingForce|Peaces}}</ref> He was once interviewed by [[Melanda Forswoth]] for [[Eye on Cularin]] with regard to knowledge on the [[Caarite]]s and their homeworld of [[Caarimon]].<ref name="Stories of Caarimon">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/swlf20030501caarimon|text=Stories of Caarimon}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Yasin appeared at the ''[[Peaces]]'' interactive adventure as part of the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|Living Force campaign]]. He was played by [[Sean Orwin]], pictured here with [[Sarah Bruner]].
